title: perf(canary): auto-detect perf regressions and add rollout guards
author: Maya Chen
description: Add automated performance canary detection and rollout guards to prevent degraded latency/throughput from reaching production. Motivation: recent regressions slipped through silent canaries when median latency moved +15% on p50-sensitive endpoints. This PR implements a canary scoring pipeline (statistical comparison with A/B bootstrap + effect-size threshold), integrates detection into the rollout controller so that deploys automatically pause/rollback when canary_score > threshold, exposes a config toggle and per-route thresholds, and wires up alerting and dashboards. Changes include service and evaluator code, rollout controller hooks, metrics/tracing, unit + integration tests, and docs. Checklist: - add robust canary scorer with bootstrap A/B test and noise modeling - integrate scorer with perf-canary service and rollout controller - expose per-route thresholds in rollout config and console - alerting for sustained regressions and automated rollback events - tests: unit/e2e/benchmarks updated - docs and migration notes added. Related Linear: ENG-1289 (canary pipeline), ENG-1321 (rollout guards).
commits: scorer: add bootstrap A/B canary scoring (statistical tests + effect sizes)
service: integrate scorer into perf-canary ingestion path and evaluation worker
rollout: pause and rollback hooks when canary_score exceeds route threshold
tests: add deterministic unit tests and e2e scenario simulating latency regression
docs: rollout guard config and migration notes

release_notes: Added automatic performance canary detection and rollout guards. New configuration available to set per-route canary thresholds; default conservative thresholds prevent automated rollouts on detected regressions. This improves production safety for latency-sensitive routes.
